name: Gym Guardian
tagline: Gym Guardian BMS with structured operational licensing and agreement-backed delivery.
shortDescription: A licensed gym management system with subscription pricing, compliance rules, and secure operations.
fullDescription: Gym Guardian is delivered under a formal agreement that defines deployment, licensing, maintenance, and operational support for gym businesses.

features.title: Production UI/UX
features.description: Mobile-first responsive interface with polished operational workflows.

features.title: Omnichannel POS
features.description: Cashier terminal support for cash, manual USSD, and walk-in transaction logging.

features.title: Digital Relational Ledger
features.description: Automated member IDs and ledger tracking replacing paper-based records.

features.title: Absolute Gate Tracking
features.description: Real-time check-in logging with validation for member access and capacity control.

features.title: RRA Compliance Ledger
features.description: Revenue, expenditure, VAT, and CIT reporting outputs for local accounting workflows.

features.title: Business Intelligence
features.description: Live dashboards for retention, revenue, and member activity across branches.

pricing_tiers.name: Operational Subscription
pricing_tiers.capacity: Full system capabilities within the standard resource cap

use_cases.title: Independent Gym
use_cases.description: Single location fitness centers managing daily operations and member relationships efficiently.

use_cases.title: Franchise Network
use_cases.description: Multi-location gyms with centralized billing, reporting, and member management across all sites.

use_cases.title: Specialty Studios
use_cases.description: Yoga, Pilates, CrossFit, or boutique fitness studios with class-focused scheduling and member engagement.

tech_stack.security: Enterprise-grade encryption, SOC 2 Type II compliant
